items.title: Fleming frontrunner to become England Test coach
items.summary: Former New Zealand captain Stephen Fleming is the frontrunner to be appointed as England men's Test head coach.

items.title: Uefa to hold emergency meeting over Fifa World Cup plans
items.summary: European football's governing body Uefa will hold a meeting of all 55 member associations on Thursday afternoon to discuss its response to Fifa's controversial World Cup plans.
